original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情致逾5000人死亡，为该国有史以来最严重疫情
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据政府数据，刚果（金）持续暴发的埃博拉疫情已造成超过5000人死亡，确诊病例超过1.03万例，26个省份中有8个受影响。疫情于5月暴发，8月成为该国历史上最致命的一次，当前病死率为48.6%。疫情中心位于冲突地区伊图里省，给防控工作带来困难；肯尼亚、尼日利亚和乌干达也已报告确诊病例。

location.raw_text: Ituri province, north-east of DR Congo

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情已致超过5000人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 5,000 people have died from an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, government data shows.

key_facts.fact: 确诊病例超过1.03万例，26个省份中有8个受影响
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Eight of 26 provinces are now affected, with more than 10,300 confirmed cases.
The current case fatality rate is 48.6%.

key_facts.fact: 疫情中心位于冲突地区伊图里省
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the epicentre of the epidemic remains in the Ituri province, in the north-east of the country, which is a conflict zone, making it harder to contain the virus.

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚、尼日利亚和乌干达已报告确诊病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Cases have also been confirmed in Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda.

key_facts.fact: 一名护士在应对埃博拉警报时遇袭身亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured in an attack when responding to an Ebola alert.

uncertainties: 尼日利亚两例疑似病例尚在检测中，尚未确诊
疫情结束所需时间尚不确定
单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
